about_the_game:
Zoo Wars Demo lets you experience the charm of this real-time competitive tower defense game where cute animals and fruits clash in fast-paced battles.
Play three CPU matches and get a feel for the strategic deck-building and quick decisions that define the full game.

In the full version, you can enjoy online battles and zoo customization features!

◆ Features

  • Simple rules, deep strategy

  • Cute animals & powerful fruit cards

  • Fast, 2-minute battles

  • CPU battles available in this demo
